standard_prerequisites: vanishing of higher direct images under affine morphisms, so f_*O_X -> Rf_*O_X is an isomorphism (Cohomology of Spaces, Lemma spaces-cohomology-lemma-affine-vanishing-higher-direct-images)
the canonical projection map E tensor^L Rf_*O_X -> Rf_* Lf^* E adjoint to the counit Lf^*Rf_*O_X -> O_X

the comparison of D_QCoh on the etale site with schemes (lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site of the same chapter) and the compatibility of total direct images (remark-match-total-direct-images of the same chapter)
the scheme projection formula for affine morphisms (Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma perfect-lemma-affine-morphism-pull-push)
core_obligations: Prove that for an affine morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces and E in D_QCoh(O_Y), one has Rf_* Lf^* E = E tensor^L_{O_Y} f_*O_X
proof_roadmap: Affineness identifies f_*O_X with Rf_*O_X, and there is a canonical map E tensor^L f_*O_X -> Rf_* Lf^* E adjoint to the counit-based map on Lf^*.
The question is local on Y, so assume Y affine, hence X affine.
Via the comparison lemma and the total direct image compatibility the affine case reduces to the scheme projection formula.
difficulty_reason: H2: a projection formula proved by reduction to the scheme case through affineness.
